utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive this weekend, or did the plan change?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on for the weekend — same plan as before. I’ll swing by after my errands and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. What time do you think you’ll be by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand and bring over the tools if you need them. What’s the repair drive working on first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think we’re starting with the wobbly fence and then maybe the loose steps, if we can get to them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it — I can bring the hammer, drill, and a few clamps for the fence, then we can take a look at the steps after that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of support already—people are really showing up. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—I’m just hoping the logistics stay manageable. Please let me know if they need any extra hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I will—if they start needing extra hands or supplies, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of help do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m collecting the repair items and need to know which houses have already been checked. Can you tell me the next stop?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, if that’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, the repair drive’s coming up soon — want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, thanks, Quinn. Please do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you right now and send the details when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m organizing the repair drive list now, and it’s coming together nicely. If you’ve got any homes or supplies to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I don’t have anything to add right now, but I can help if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be wonderful, Leo — I may take you up on that when we start sorting the list. I’ll let you know as soon as I need help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and exact drop-off spot for the repair drive? I want to make sure I have every detail right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the date, time, or exact drop-off spot yet. I’ll check and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — please let me know as soon as you have the details, and I’ll help then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the repair drive details so you can coordinate around pickup. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Mara — once I have them, I’ll fit everything around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming along nicely—folks are dropping off tools and a few volunteers have already signed up. I can fill you in on the details if you want the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh yes, please—give me the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the basics for the repair drive and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you want the basics for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, just the basics is perfect — a quick summary and what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help where I can—what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. Mostly little things folks keep putting off: leaky faucets, loose door hinges, squeaky steps, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I can help with the small stuff and check what tools we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring it up with a few neighbors and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of the supplies and make a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll check in with a few folks and let you know who can pitch in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily — folks have been dropping off tools and a few supplies. I’m still checking in with people one by one to see what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear. If you want, I can swing by later and see what’s still needed most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, but you may need to remind me what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need a few more tools and a couple volunteers, and I’m going to remind everyone at the block tonight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit behind, what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still collecting donations and spare parts. I can send you the current list and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help — send me the list and drop-off details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s meet by the drive at 9, and I’ll bring the list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and pull out anything that needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing, Mara — could you help rally a few neighbors and maybe bring a couple tools on Saturday? I’ll send the details right over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to a few neighbors and bring a couple of tools on Saturday. Send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a nice way to help folks out together. Want to start with the bigger fixes or the quick wins?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the quick wins so we can get a few easy stops logged, then move on to the bigger fixes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll jot down the easy stops first, then we can tackle the bigger repairs after.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive details lined up, and I’m happy to help coordinate anything we need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — that’s a big help. I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll stay in touch and help fill any gaps as we go. Just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting soon—if you need help, I can spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Can you tell me when it starts and where people should bring repairs?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of the exact details yet, but I can ask around and let you know as soon as I hear. If you want, I’ll also spread the word about where to bring things once I find out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what needs fixing, and when’s the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’ve got a few things like loose chairs, a leaky faucet, and one stubborn door latch. The drive is this Saturday morning after drop-off, so I’m trying to keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help with the chairs or the door latch. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still okay helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9 and ready to help.
